messages:
jules: FYI found a suspicious layer in a nightly base image: /usr/local/bin is world-writable and one binary has setuid. We should pause any promotions until we confirm signer/KMS bindings. digest: sha256:beefc0ffee000111
marco: Oof. Which builder signed that image?
jules: It shows signed by ci-bot@redwood. But CI is supposed to only have staging signer, not prod. Link: https://artifacts.example/images/7890
priya: Can you paste the output of `cosign verify`?
jules: Output:
```
$ cosign verify gcr.io/redwood/base-nightly:2026-03-21
Verified OK : sha256:beefc0ffee000111
Repository: gcr.io/redwood/base-nightly
Signed by: ci-bot@redwood
Key: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/prod-main/cryptoKeyVersions/7
```
lena: That key binding is wrong. prod-main should only be writable by the image-signer service account with MFA/approval workflow. Who can edit IAM on that KMS key?
ops-bot: KMS IAM: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter -> members: serviceAccount:ci-bot@redwood, group:key_admins@redwood
sec-bot: Alert: world-writable dir and setuid binary flagged by image-scan (CWE-732/CWE-250). Severity: high.
marco: Immediate actions: (1) add digest to promotion denylist, (2) revoke ci-bot KMS binding, (3) start rebuild with minimal base (distroless) + nonroot user, (4) ensure cosign attestation has provenance claiming build pipeline id. Agree?
jules: Yup. I'll add denylist entry now.
ops-bot: denylist updated: sha256:beefc0ffee000111 added (TTL 96h)
priya: On KMS side I'll prepare a conditional IAM policy: allow cryptoSign only when request.auth.claim.pipeline == "prod-image-signer" and request.time within window. That gives us ephemeral signing without wide SA perms.
lena: Also we need audit retention: export Cloud Audit logs for cloudkms.sign to security project BigQuery for 13 months. I'll file that ticket.
marco: For the rebuild, use these quick steps:
```
# build with non-root and strip setuid bits
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot
COPY --from=builder /out/shim /usr/local/bin/shim
USER 65532:65532
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/shim"]
# ensure no suid
RUN find / -perm /6000 -type f -exec chmod a-s {} + || true
```
priya: Also add runtime enforcement: containerd OCI hook that runs `cosign verify` before allowed to start. If verify fails, runtime should emit structured audit (json) to stackdriver and block. We can implement as an admission hook in the cluster too.
jules: Who owns the IAM rotation ticket? I'll need someone to remove ci-bot from prod KMS immediately.
lena: I'll take IAM ticket. Plan: remove ci-bot, add ephemeral-signer@redwood with IAM condition + require approvals via the approvals service. I'll update the ticket with commands.
marco: Add monitoring: metric image.signature.rejected and an alert if >0 in 1 minute during rollout. Also emit a trace/span showing verify duration for perf.
sec-bot: Recommended checklist attached: 1) block digest from promotion, 2) revoke key perms, 3) rebuild minimal image non-root, 4) sign with rotated key, 5) runtime verify + audit, 6) BQ export for audit logs, 7) postmortem if root cause is pipeline compromise.
jules: Scheduled a 20-min sync at 12:00 PT to coordinate rebuild + IAM rotation + SRE denylist change. I'll DM invites.
priya: I'll prepare the cosign commands for rotation:
```
# create new key version and sign with KMS
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/prod-main/cryptoKeyVersions/8 gcr.io/redwood/base-nightly:2026-03-21-rebuilt
# verify
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/prod-main gcr.io/redwood/base-nightly:2026-03-21-rebuilt
```
marco: After rebuild and rotated signing, we'll run canary in isolated cluster with enhanced audit forwarding. If metrics stable for 24h, we can promote.
jules: Thanks all. I'll update here after IAM change and rebuild artifacts are ready. For now digest blocked and ticket filed: SEC-3456.
ops-bot: ticket SEC-3456 created and assigned to lena, priya.
marco: One more note: check GCR object ACLs; ensure no public push access. I'll run a quick scan and post results in the sync.
jules: Good call. Closing loop for now, will update once we have rotated key and new signed digest.
